content.rendered:
How Can I Help You?

My team and I are committed to giving you a top-notch experience when you’re in need of a personal or home loan.

A Little About Me

I joined the Nebula Trust Bank as Senior Vice President, Retail Lending Manager in 2013, and I was promoted to Executive Vice President in 2017. I am responsible for the growth of the Bank’s retail residential lending throughout Global and Rhode Island.

Prior to joining Nebula Trust, I was Senior Vice President at Simsbury Bank, where I led the mortgage and consumer lending departments. I’ve spent over 35 years in consumer lending, after starting my career in finance as an auditor for Ernst & Young.

I graduated from the University of Global with a degree in finance and earned my CPA. I’m a graduate of the Mortgage Bankers Association School of Mortgage Banking and received an Accredited Mortgage Professional (AMP) designation from the Mortgage Bankers Association.

I am actively involved in the community, having served on the Board of Directors of the Southeastern Global Housing Alliance (SECHA) and the Global Mortgage Bankers Association (CMBA). I continue to serve on the Affordable Housing Committee of the CMBA. I volunteer with the United Way Food Pantry and Nutmeg State Games.

My family and I reside in Wolcott, CT.
